logline: A superhuman young woman raised in Mongolia returns to Seoul's Gangnam to find her mother and ends up dismantling a billion-dollar drug empire.

renewal.note: 16-episode limited run concluded November 26, 2023 on JTBC. A spin-off of the 2017 series Strong Girl Bong-soon, written by the same writer Baek Mi-kyung as a standalone story.

bollymeter.basis: The finale recorded 10.42% nationwide on Nielsen Korea - strong numbers for cable. However, critics noted the drug-trafficking plot failed to match the charm of the supernatural premise, with mixed reviews from international outlets.

seasons.review_body: Strong Girl Nam-soon aired October through November 2023 on JTBC, also streaming on Netflix internationally. A spin-off of the beloved 2017 hit Strong Girl Bong-soon, the series introduces a new superhuman protagonist raised in Mongolia who returns to Gangnam in search of her parents and gets drawn into a drug investigation. The finale peaked at 10.42% nationwide, validating the franchise's commercial pull. However, critics were more divided than the original - the show's tonal inconsistency between its action-comedy premise and dark drug storyline drew comment from Korean entertainment press. Lee Yoo-mi's physical commitment in the action sequences earned praise, and the three-generation super-strength family dynamic provided moments of genuine warmth. Byeon Woo-seok's stylish villainy contributed to the show's breakout social media presence even as the plot mechanics disappointed some reviewers.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere efficiently establishes the superhuman family mythology across three generations and sets Nam-soon's origin - abandoned in Mongolia, impossibly strong, searching for identity. The Gangnam setting is deployed with comedic self-awareness. Lee Yoo-mi makes an immediate impression as a physically committed, warmly played lead.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Nam-soon's first casual display of superhuman strength in the middle of Seoul traffic - played for deadpan comedy in a way the original series earned.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 16
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale resolves the drug cartel arc with action-heavy setpieces that showcase the series' visual ambitions. The family reunion elements land emotionally, though the crime procedural threads resolve more mechanically. The 10.42% finale rating confirmed strong domestic audience attachment.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The three-generation superhero family uniting for the climactic confrontation - a crowd-pleasing moment that pays off the show's core premise.
